# netcup_server_iso (Resource)

An ISO attached to a netcup server (SCP REST API), one per server. Attaching is asynchronous; the provider waits for completion. netcup does not return `iso_id`, `user_iso_name` or `change_boot_device_to_cdrom`, so an import leaves them empty and the next plan replaces the resource. `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [iso_id, user_iso_name, change_boot_device_to_cdrom] }` avoids that.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "iso_name" {
  type = string
}

data "netcup_server_iso_images" "available" {
  server_id = 12345
}

resource "netcup_server_iso" "installer" {
  server_id                   = 12345
  iso_id                      = one([for iso in data.netcup_server_iso_images.available.iso_images : iso.id if iso.name == var.iso_name])
  change_boot_device_to_cdrom = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `change_boot_device_to_cdrom` (Boolean) Whether attaching changes the boot device to CD-ROM.
- `iso_id` (Number) Id of the ISO, from the `netcup_server_iso_images` data source. Exactly one of `iso_id` and `user_iso_name` is needed.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_iso_name` (String) Name of an uploaded ISO.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equals `server_id`.
- `iso` (String) The attached ISO as netcup names it.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <server_id>
terraform import netcup_server_iso.installer 12345
```
